title: 技能补两句：AI 可调用的不可逆动作要设 ai.requiresConfirmation；私有对象的删除权只删自己的记录
body:
epic:#5027#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMUfmNYTem26rXLFUf

Filing gate: ② seat-found, from the objectstack-ai/cloud#5080 itemisation (comment https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/5080#issuecomment-7207375342, recordings `/mnt/project-files/trials/cloud-5031/runs.tgz`, the nine `g1d-afterbb-*` door builds). Premises re-checked by that thread on objectstack `origin/main` ce4d8c7d.
Parent: objectstack-ai/cloud#5027 (M2 Build line: median 101/112 = 90.2%, the line is 107/112).
Grading: area:ai · domain:skills · Task · p2 · size XS · reach: every agent that builds actions or permission sets from the published skills.
Dedupe: searched `requiresConfirmation actions.md`, `owner_only_deletes skill`: none.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：两条平台规则技能里没写，智能体照技能做就会丢分：一是 AI 能调用的不可逆动作必须打开「需要确认」，二是私有对象上给了删除权，也只能删自己的记录。
- 影响：中位数各 +1，补上后加上前两张卡可到 108/112（96.4%）。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What to do
1. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` (~:49): after the `confirmText` sentence, say `confirmText` is dialog copy only, and an AI-exposed irreversible action also needs `ai.requiresConfirmation: true`.
2. The skill that teaches permission sets (`skills/objectstack-data` or `objectstack-platform`, wherever `allowDelete` is taught): `allowDelete` on a `private` object deletes only rows the user owns (`owner_only_deletes`); to widen, `writeScope: 'org'` plus a row policy, or `modifyAllRecords`.
3. Net line budget for `skills/**`: +4 lines at most; respect the skill line ratchet. Add or extend one skill eval case per rule.
